attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Verification Failed
attributes.description: Detects a failed recovery verification, validation, or recovery-test event.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a failed recovery verification, validation, or recovery-test event.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
)
and (
  message:*verif*
  or message:*validat*
  or message:*test*
)
and (
  event.outcome:"failure"
  or event.outcome:"failure"
  or message:*failed*
)
